test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

The workers __has called up__ the strike.
solution: The correct answer is** 'have called off'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'have called off'** should be used instead of **'has called up'.** • In the given sentence** 'the workers' **is **a plural noun.** Hence,** a plural helping verb **should be used. • **Called off: **to decide that something will not happen. • *Example: She’s** called off** the wedding.* • Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.** **Correct Sentence:__** *The workers **have called off **the strike.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां **'have called off'** की जगह** 'has called off'** का इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए। • दिए गए वाक्य में **'the workers' **एक** plural noun **है। इसलिए, एक **plural helping verb **का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • **Called off: **यह तय करने के लिए कि कुछ नहीं होगा। • *Example: She’s** called off **the wedding.* • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 4** है। 39:Tb33, The correct answer is '**Block**'.
